lore: Before every sailing, Quartermaster Bram weighs each island's cargo on the harbour scales and chalks the load against the waterline on the hull. He keeps a short list nailed to the gangway: the heaviest crates first, and which single crate, thrown off, would lift a sinking island back above the line.

lines.light: Every hull rides high. Plenty of room in the holds.
lines.laden: We are near the waterline. Check the list on the gangway before loading more.
lines.overladen: An island is riding under the line. Throw off the first crate on my list and she floats.
